target_customer: Frontier coding agent labs and frontend developers (originally React developers wanting faster apps)
problem: Coding agents generate code faster than it can be verified, and React apps were slow. Million began as a React optimizing compiler and now sells environments and evals for coding agents.
business_model: Open source developer tools with a commercial layer, now data, environments and evals for agent labs
product_category: Developer tools and AI agent verification

founders.name: Aiden Bai
founders.background_notes: YC page says he wrote an optimizing compiler for React in high school that reached 14K+ GitHub stars.

founders.name: Nisarg Patel
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: A compiler augmented virtual DOM for React was research grade enough to be published on arXiv (2022 identifier). Agent verification and benchmarks are also hard.

defensibility.rationale: Open source MIT licensed code is copyable. The edge is community trust and GitHub stars (about 22k for React Scan and 15k for React Doctor per the site).

takeover_risk_then.outcome: React Compiler from the React team overlaps the original wedge. No acquisition of Million found.

market_need_then: React performance complaints were common and Million.js had adoption in open source projects (85 per the founder's 2023 paper snippet). Later demand shifted to agent verification as coding agents spread.

identity.logo: Friendly lion mascot named Mil, per a Cisco community post surfaced in search, low reliability
identity.visual_style: Playful technical, header art of mechanical arms playing Go in a library

branding.community_and_virality: Open source community with 40+ contributors per the Million.js Foundation page, a JS Party podcast episode, and 14 named angel backers on the site including Scott Wu, Amjad Masad and Evan You.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong developer mindshare through open source stars and podcast coverage, but the common word name is generic and search results mix with unrelated companies.

pivots.from: React optimizing compiler and Million Lint
pivots.to: Environments and evals for frontier coding agents and agent verification
pivots.why: YC page and company site now describe agent verification; no dated source found

outcome_analysis: Million is active and has pivoted from a React performance compiler toward verification data for coding agents. Developer goodwill from open source and star counts is the main asset, but no verified funding or revenue data exists, so the trajectory is unknown rather than good or bad.
notes: Unverified aggregator claims only: seed or pre-seed of $500K (Jan 2024 to Apr 2025, dates conflict) and a $13.6M Series A in June 2025 (Everydev, CB Insights, no investors confirmed). These aggregators also link the company to a prior name 'Same', which conflicts with the YC listing and was not confirmed. No dated competitor sources found near the batch, so the list is empty. No outcome news found.
